node.title: Re: If I'm matching a pattern wy does a + sign make things crazy? (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I doubt it has anything to do with a + character, more likely it's to do with the fact that .* is greedy and you've got two links on the same line, as [Corion] [id://11116472|said].

Yes, I realize that Perl regex is not the way to go to find links.

Correct! Sorry, but in regards to "my method works": it's not really working, though. And even if you fix this one issue with this one input, the next problem will certainly pop up - see [id://1201438|this node] for how complex parsing HTML gets*. In this case, there's a very well established module for that, [mod://HTML::LinkExtor]. [mod://Mojo::DOM] also works:

use Mojo::DOM; my $dom = Mojo::DOM->new(<<'END_HTML'); a b c END_HTML $dom->find('a[href]')->each(sub { print "$_ / ",$_->{href}," / ",$_->all_text,"\n"; });

Edited second paragraph.

* Update: [id://11116478]
